sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can accurately use indirect jussive clauses (arra kér / azt követeli, hogy + subjunctive) and negative purpose clauses with nehogy
I can deploy deliberative subjunctive questions and concessive jussive structures (Legyen bármilyen ... is)
I can actively use Unit 4's B2 vocabulary of drama, rhetoric, and persuasion
